title: Industry physicist reads the propulsion technology from unreleased frames

tellings.quote: now. We spent observation in March and February, which were revealed to us technology that is used.

plain: A man named James Valor, from a startup called Skywatcher that tries to summon UFOs and film them, says that sky watching his team did in February and March 2025 showed them what technology the objects use. In the story, a physicist from industry read how the craft move from frames of footage that have not been released, which would mean the propulsion can be studied from the images. Valor tells it as part of the team, saying the observation "revealed to us technology that is used."
